T:P1.1.text: Cardinal Infrastructure Group | Cardinal Infrastructure Group

T:P1.2.text: Cardinal Infrastructure Group is a civil infrastructure and site development services provider operating in the Southeast that is delivering integrity from the ground up.

T:P1.3.text: Civil Infrastructure Services, Delivering Integrity from the Ground Up

T:P1.4.text: Across the Southeast, the neighborhoods, commercial developments, roads and other infrastructure taking shape all start in the same place: the ground. Cardinal Infrastructure Group is a vertically integrated civil infrastructure and site development platform serving residential, commercial, industrial and municipal projects.

T:P1.5.text: Our operating companies self-perform site work from preconstruction to paving, including grading, site clearing, erosion control, underground utilities, drilling and blasting, and asphalt paving. Bringing multiple phases of the work under one accountable team gives our clients a single point of responsibility across the site.

T:P1.6.text: Every decision is guided by doing what's right and what creates long-term value for everyone.

T:P1.7.text: Site development across multiple phases, under one accountable team.

T:P1.8.text: Local expertise. Shared standards. One Cardinal.

T:P1.9.text: Vertically integrated. Disciplined acquirer. Founder led.

T:P1.10.text: The strongest relationships we build are inside our company. At Cardinal, we hire the right people and trust them to uphold our standards.

T:P1.11.text: One company, with crews, equipment and expertise across the Southeast.

T:P2.2.text: Cardinal Infrastructure Group delivers end to end civil construction and site development through a vertically integrated, self performing platform.

T:P2.7.text: Bringing multiple phases under one team means one point of accountability for the site, and fewer gaps between phases. Our team is responsible for the scope, and you get work done to our standards and results we answer for directly.

T:P2.8.text: With work sequenced in-house, we anticipate what's next and keep work moving. Having access to the crews, equipment and resources to keep your project moving helps us deliver on tight schedules.

C:P1.1.text: Construction Partners Inc. | Building Connected Communities

C:P1.2.text: We're a vertically integrated civil infrastructure company operating across eight Sunbelt states. Our hot-mix asphalt plants, aggregate facilities, and liquid asphalt terminals support our focus on constructing, repairing, and maintaining surface infrastructure.

C:P1.3.text: We are a family of companies dedicated to building better lives and the infrastructure that keeps our communities connected.

C:P1.4.text: A Leading Asphalt-Centered Infrastructure Company in the Sunbelt Region

C:P1.5.text: We are a vertically integrated civil infrastructure company operating in local markets throughout eight Sunbelt states. Our hot-mix asphalt plants, aggregate facilities, and liquid asphalt terminals support our focus on constructing, repairing, and maintaining surface infrastructure.

C:P1.6.text: Asphalt Solutions for the Road Ahead

C:P1.7.text: Construction Partners operates a network of asphalt plants, construction teams, liquid asphalt terminals, and aggregate facilities that work together to support its projects and customers. This integrated approach improves efficiency, ensures reliability, and creates long-term value in the markets it serves.

C:P1.8.text: Dedicated teams across our family of companies deliver quality, safety, and service that define who we are.

C:P1.9.text: Each company is locally led and community-focused, building the roads and connections that bring people together.

C:P1.10.text: Our family of companies serves communities across Alabama, Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, Oklahoma, and Texas. Construction Partners supports its companies and local teams in successfully building and operating in the markets they serve.

C:P2.3.text: Construction Partners was built on a clear and focused vision: to acquire and partner with locally led infrastructure companies that share a commitment to quality, safety, and family values.
